item.description: EUROPEAN SESSIONIn the European session, the main highlight is the Swiss CPI report. The CPI Y/Y is expected at 0.0% vs 0.1% prior. item.title: Oil prices resume climb despite Trump's assurance on Strait of Hormuz
item.description: WTI crude oil came close to hitting $78 yesterday before falling back after Trump gave his assurance, at least financially, on passage through the Strait of Hormuz here. But even so, it seems that no company is willing to take on that promise and risk getting their tankers shot down by the IRGC.Again, the Strait of Hormuz is not officially closed per se.
